name: @filament/openclaw-filament-fcm
description: OpenClaw plugin that connects an agent to Filament via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) pushes — or, opt-in, a poll_work long-poll — and the Filament MCP-over-HTTP agents API.

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts src/util.ts src/accounts.ts src/gateway.ts src/token-store.ts src/mcp-client.ts src/settings.ts src/credentials.ts src/connect.ts src/work-item.ts src/transports/types.ts src/transports/poll/index.ts src/transports/poll/poll-work.ts src/transports/fcm/index.ts src/transports/fcm/receiver.ts src/transports/fcm/decode.ts src/transports/fcm/wake-policy.ts src/transports/fcm/reply-route.ts src/onboarding-core.ts src/filament-tools.ts src/channel.ts src/turn.ts --outdir=dist --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --sourcemap && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/filament-tools.snapshot.json','dist/src/filament-tools.snapshot.json')"
scripts.test: esbuild src/onboarding-core.test.ts src/mcp-client.test.ts src/credentials.test.ts src/settings.test.ts src/transports/poll/poll-work.test.ts src/transports/fcm/index.test.ts src/transports/fcm/decode.test.ts src/transports/fcm/wake-policy.test.ts src/transports/fcm/reply-route.test.ts src/filament-tools.test.ts src/accounts.test.ts src/gateway.test.ts --bundle --external:openclaw --external:@eneris/push-receiver --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist-test --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test dist-test/onboarding-core.test.mjs dist-test/mcp-client.test.mjs dist-test/credentials.test.mjs dist-test/settings.test.mjs dist-test/transports/poll/poll-work.test.mjs dist-test/transports/fcm/index.test.mjs dist-test/transports/fcm/decode.test.mjs dist-test/transports/fcm/wake-policy.test.mjs dist-test/transports/fcm/reply-route.test.mjs dist-test/filament-tools.test.mjs dist-test/accounts.test.mjs dist-test/gateway.test.mjs
